flatModel.description: Case-insensitive substring match on flat model, e.g. Improved, Maisonette (casing varies by era in the source).
flatModel.title: Flat model contains

flatType.description: Case-insensitive substring match on flat type, e.g. 4 ROOM, EXECUTIVE.
flatType.title: Flat type contains

limit.description: Maximum resale rows pushed to the dataset. Leave empty to return all matching rows.
limit.title: Max rows returned

mode.description: rows = matching resale rows to the dataset; analytics = derived analytics to the key-value store (record ANALYTICS); both = both.
mode.title: Mode

monthFrom.description: Earliest month to include, YYYY-MM, e.g. 2020-01. Archive starts 1990-01.
monthFrom.title: Month from

monthTo.description: Latest month to include, YYYY-MM, e.g. 2026-11.
monthTo.title: Month to

town.description: Case-insensitive substring match on town, e.g. TAMPINES.
town.title: Town contains
